title: Lanterns Below Marrow Hill
summary: Two companions descend into an old hill shrine to recover a vanished village lantern before the road goes dark for good.

quickPlay.name: Quick-Play Edition
quickPlay.description: A complete low-cost edition with browser story mode and simple print-and-play files.

deluxe.name: Deluxe Edition
deluxe.description: A premium edition with enhanced browser story mode, illustrated scene art, detailed maps, and deluxe printable files.

browserStory.name: Browser Story Mode
browserStory.description: Play on phone, iPad, tablet, or desktop as a read-along choice-driven adventure. No printing required.

printAndPlay.name: Print & Play Mode
printAndPlay.description: Print maps, tokens, role sheets, clue cards, and ending cards for a tabletop-style experience.
